meta.source: Built from the Pi Workbench canvas (1-bit Desktop Interface redesign) and the pi-local-harness front end (index.html, chat.css, js/*.mjs).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground of every window, menu, field, dialog and sheet. Text and borders on it are always ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, borders, icons, window shadows and the desktop dots. The only foreground colour: 21:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and menu items, placeholder text. 4.5:1 on paper (light), 6.6:1 (dark). Never for readable body text.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Pointer hover on list rows, menu titles and view tabs only. Never a resting state, never behind text that must be read at rest.

tokens.name: selection-bg
tokens.usage: Selected row, open menu title, pressed button, selected segment, highlighted menu item, text selection. Selection is shown by inversion, never by a hue.

tokens.name: selection-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on selection-bg.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Desktop ground behind windows. Overlaid with the desk-dot pattern (1px ink dot every 4px).

tokens.name: desk-dot
tokens.usage: The desktop dot pattern and the 50% dither used for scroll tracks and modal scrims.

styles.name: chrome-menu
styles.usage: Menu bar titles and menu items. Commands are Title Case verbs; an ellipsis means a dialog follows.

styles.name: chrome-button
styles.usage: Buttons, view tabs, popups, window titles.

styles.name: chrome-label
styles.usage: Field labels, status text, list rows in dense tables.

styles.name: chrome-meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, shortcuts, info-bar and footer text, column headers.

styles.name: chrome-marker
styles.usage: Comment markers in running text. Nothing else.

styles.name: chrome-heading
styles.usage: Dialog and sheet titles, detail-pane headings.

styles.name: touch-label
styles.usage: Every chrome text at phone width (≤760px): buttons, menu rows, sheet actions.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: A document's first heading. 26px/31px at phone width.

styles.name: doc-heading
styles.usage: Headings inside documents (h2–h6 step down by 2px, floor 18px).

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Projects live in the left rail.
styles.usage: Document blocks in the Work editor. 17px at phone width.

styles.name: chat-body
styles.usage: Chat messages, the composer, document requests.

styles.name: comment-body
styles.sample: Activity is missing from this list.
styles.usage: Comment threads, review items, alert explanations, Laya reasons.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands in tool-call cards, code blocks, Markdown source mode.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in glyphs, gaps inside a status line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; between label and field; list-row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Info-bar and toolbar padding; thread message padding (vertical 10, horizontal 14).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Composer and panel padding; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between windows at 1200px and narrower.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop padding and gap between windows; gap between chat messages is 28px (space-6 + space-1).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Transcript side padding; document side padding is 40–56px.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Document column side padding at desktop width.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Windows, menus, fields, dialogs, list tables, tool-call cards. The default: square is the system.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Push buttons, view-tab ends, segmented-control ends.

tokens.name: radius-button-default
tokens.usage: The default button, whose 3px outer ring follows at 2px distance.

tokens.name: radius-touch
tokens.usage: Push buttons at 44px touch height.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Your own chat messages. Pi's messages have no frame.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Every window, menu, floating toolbar, inline thread and toast.

tokens.name: shadow-popup
tokens.usage: Popup menus (select controls).

tokens.name: shadow-default-ring
tokens.usage: The default button: the one Return presses. At most one per window, dialog or sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-field
tokens.usage: Text fields and text areas: a 2px top-left inner edge.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and alerts: the double frame that says the app waits for an answer.

tokens.name: size-menubar
tokens.usage: Menu bar height on desktop; 48px at phone width.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Window title bar height; stripes are 11px tall, 1px on 1px off.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: List rows (projects, files). Table rows 34–36px.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, popups and segments on desktop.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target at phone width; every control grows to it.

tokens.name: size-scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scroll bar width; arrow boxes are 16×16.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Max width of the Projects and Files windows (min 260px).

tokens.name: size-review
tokens.usage: Review window width.

tokens.name: size-doc-column
tokens.usage: Max width of the document column (~65 characters at doc-body).

breakpoint.note: One breakpoint, the one js/chat.mjs already uses.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: At or below: the menu bar becomes the phone bar, windows go full-screen, side windows become sheets, every control is 44px.
